The absent or typed subject filter executes one fixed SELECT, uses at most one bind and preserves strict q.id ASC order.
Raw nullable and malformed values remain intact across the catalog boundary so operations can reproduce legacy projections without data loss.
Operations owns both routes, authentication, query-string parsing, Session activity, defaults, envelopes and safe errors.
The modern and legacy success envelopes remain intentionally distinct and no approved difference erases that distinction.
The active frozen Web caller targets the legacy path; the modern caller template is dormant and is not represented as active traffic.
SQLite raw-text integer comparison observations are explicitly engine-scoped and cannot authorize PostgreSQL route migration.
All 44 cases preserve complete questions, subjects and identity fact fingerprints and attempt no catalog DML or DDL.
Both HTTP operations remain pending with zero production cutover and no route or OpenAPI migration delta.
